title: Inventory hepatitis B perinatal prevention data sources and measures
outcome: A dated source inventory and measure dictionary separating maternal HBsAg screening, prophylaxis events, birth-dose timing, infant-series completion, and impact validation.
inputs: WHO global hepatitis report and current hepatitis B fact sheet
WHO hepatitis B vaccine position paper and 2024 chronic-HBV guideline
laboratory, birth-registration, and EPI dose records
expected_artifact: datasets.md update plus evidence.json records for each accepted source family.
validation_method: Domain reviewer checks each source for URL, title identity, date, event grain, numerator, denominator, timing field, missingness, access conditions, and an explicit non-use boundary.
done_condition: At least seven candidate source families are classified as usable, limited, or rejected with explicit reasons covering maternal screening, prophylaxis, birth-dose timing, infant-series completion, impact validation, linkage, and missingness.

title: Define a hepatitis B perinatal cascade measure dictionary
outcome: A reproducible stage-level data dictionary for maternal screening, prophylaxis, timely birth dose, infant-series completion, and impact validation.
inputs: WHO hepatitis B definitions and recommendations
one named country's antenatal, maternity, laboratory, and EPI data dictionary
expected_artifact: validation.md update with stage definitions, numerator and denominator rules, timing windows, and missingness categories.
validation_method: Replicator reconstructs each stage from a de-identified sample and confirms that policy, stock, late doses, and unknown timing cannot enter a timely-dose numerator.
done_condition: A reviewer can reconstruct every cascade stage from a de-identified sample and identify the denominator, time window, exclusion rule, and missingness category for every included or excluded episode.

title: Audit linkage and missingness in hepatitis B birth-dose records
outcome: A documented audit of duplicate tests, unmatched maternal-infant episodes, missing birth or dose times, private-sector omissions, and home-birth coverage.
inputs: de-identified antenatal, maternity, laboratory, birth, and EPI tables
validation_method: Replicator reruns duplicate, match-rate, timing-window, private-sector, home-birth, and missingness calculations from the documented input hash and environment.
done_condition: The audit reports match rates and missingness by cascade stage and shows how at least one plausible linkage failure changes the estimated bottleneck without exposing identifiable records.

title: Test a country-level timely birth-dose bottleneck
outcome: A reproducible, country-level comparison of timely birth-dose delivery pathways with uncertainty, alternative explanations, and a named programme decision.
inputs: facility, home-birth, stock, and service-hour context
expected_artifact: outputs.md bottleneck analysis with an input hash, environment, rerun command, uncertainty, and non-use statement.
validation_method: Independent replicator reruns the analysis and confirms the comparison preserves timely-versus-late dosing, reports missing timing separately, and does not interpret stock or policy as administration.
done_condition: No bottleneck is described as allocation-relevant until the result is independently reproduced, its strongest alternative explanation is tested, and its named programme decision and non-use cases are recorded.

title: Red-team stigma and misuse in hepatitis B cascade outputs
outcome: A failure-mode review covering stigma, coercive screening, facility blame, privacy loss, migrant exclusion, and clinical overreach.
expected_artifact: outputs.md safety-gate update and a structured red-team review record.
validation_method: Red-team reviewer documents concrete misuse paths and a second reviewer independently replicates the failure-mode check, confirming that each path has a mitigation or publication block.
done_condition: Every proposed public or allocation-facing output is either blocked or has named safeguards for stigma, privacy, coercion, denominator error, and clinical misinterpretation.

title: Test the cascade output against a programme decision
outcome: A field-facing review that names the responsible immunization or maternal-newborn programme user, decision, timing, data burden, appeal path, and non-use cases.
expected_artifact: playbooks.md field-reality section update with a decision-use test.
validation_method: Field-reality reviewer records the workflow and a second reviewer independently replicates the check that the output does not bypass clinical, privacy, or national immunization governance.
done_condition: A named programme decision-maker can identify one responsible use, one explicit non-use, and the minimum evidence needed before acting on the output.
